lines.vo: Ever feel like the thing in front of you is way too big?
The army of Israel faced the Philistines across a valley. And every day, a giant named Goliath stepped out.
lines.title: 1 SAMUEL 17

lines.vo: He was about nine feet tall. For forty days he shouted: choose a man, and let him fight me.
King Saul and all Israel were terrified.
Then a young shepherd named David showed up, bringing food to his brothers.
He said: who is this Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?
David took no armor. Just his staff, five smooth stones, and a sling.
He told Goliath: you come against me with sword and spear. But I come against you in the name of the Lord.
David slung one stone. It struck the giant in the forehead, and he fell face down.
Because the battle belongs to the Lord.
Whatever giant you're facing today, it isn't bigger than your God.
